# Resomix Beta

> The Resomix web app: upload or pick a reference track and get ranked, sonically related matches,
> or read a detailed analysis of a single recording. Powered by the PYXIS-1 engine.

This is the product itself, not the marketing site. Most of it sits behind a sign-in, so only the
pages below are public. For what Resomix is, who it is for and how the engine works, start at
[resomix.com](https://resomix.com/) — that site carries the full description and is the canonical
source for shared pages such as pricing and contact.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://beta.resomix.com/): Start from a track and explore what belongs next to it.
- [Sonic Discovery](https://beta.resomix.com/sonic-discovery): Reference-based search — one track in, a ranked shortlist out.
- [Analysis](https://beta.resomix.com/analysis): Structure, tempo, key, energy and sonic character read from the audio.

## Behind sign-in

Library, playlists, profile, sessions and account settings require an account and are marked
`noindex`. They are listed here only so a crawler knows they exist and why they are not fetchable.

## About the company

- [About Resomix](https://resomix.com/about)
- [Trust and data handling](https://resomix.com/trust): Uploads deleted within 24 hours, partner catalogues kept in private indexes, no training on your content.
- [Contact](https://resomix.com/contact)
